newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet fuel stable in sluggish activity.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet fuel stable in sluggish activity.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices were little changed Friday afternoon amid fairly steady heating oil futures and stable differentials, traders said.
Gulf Coast aviation-quality 54-grade material was offered at 3.0 cents below February futures, while New York material saw diffs hold at about 1.75 cents over, players said.

"Liquidity stinks. It's better bid than offered," one Gulf Coast trader said, adding that differentials were facing downward pressure from allocations through January on the Colonial Pipeline despite Friday's slightly firmer heating oil diffs.
